# Sphinx Agent
> AI-powered 5-channel customer service platform

Sphinx Agent lets businesses create AI agents that handle customer support, sales, FAQ, lead capture, and appointment booking across 5 channels: web chat widget, shareable chat link, Telegram bot, AI phone agent, and browser voice. Agents are trained on business-specific knowledge and deployed in minutes.

## Key Features
- 5-channel AI agents (web widget, chat link, Telegram, phone, browser voice)
- Multi-model AI (DeepSeek, Gemini, GPT-4o)
- Custom knowledge base training
- Embeddable chat widget (single line of code)
- AI phone agent with real phone number
- Lead capture and conversation analytics
- Multilingual support (English, Spanish, and more)
- Tiered pricing (Free to Enterprise)
